# Throwable carrier with scalar contexts and result

An owned generic provider keeps one method-owned Throwable formal in a unary
producer input and its throws declaration. Three double contexts and the double
result retain their original descriptors. Four frozen callers compare 96 cases
twice, observing lazy supplier invocation, null and bad supplier results, exact
checked/runtime/Error identity, original input casts, partial writes and raw
floating-point bits. Source and SDK provider profiles compile every recovered
unit and audit all original class/member metadata and roles. Wrong programs and
Code-preserving Signature controls test the observer and binding boundary.
Only owned code and in-memory values execute.
